claims.text: Wake-promoting agents (eg, modafinil, solriamfetol) may be used as add-on treatment for excessive sleepiness with OSA, or for the 20% with residual sleepiness despite adequate CPAP.
claims.quote: Wake-promoting agents (also called wakefulness-promoting agents; eg, modafinil, solriamfetol) may be used to adjunctively treat excessive sleepiness that occurs with OSA or in the 20% of treated patients who have residual sleepiness despite adequate treatment with CPAP
